verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an official, typed, resource-oriented server SDK (`@highnote-oss/nodejs-sdk`) that wraps the API without requiring GraphQL. It also ships several official embeddable SDKs: Card Viewer, Checkout, Secure Inputs for tokenization and PINs, and Document Upload. Missing for 10: a stable (non-beta) server SDK, SDKs in languages beyond Node.js, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
